message: Imported canonical English Task 1 fixture Context 'participant/campus-wiki-fork/building-access'.

1cb2aa88-4c31-5bbc-97be-ba2ebcef1388.content: The Main Building third-floor rear entrance may be used for general passage during regular opening hours in both the academic term and recess.

a8b11b27-70d5-5077-98fb-678635369dad.content: The Main Building main entrance is on the first floor.

62214c26-4b23-5c6b-ba8a-2fb585d39421.content: The Main Building rear entrance on the opposite side of the sloping site is at the third-floor level.

4902feb8-567c-5eb9-a817-726975164f16.content: The escalator inside the Main Building connects the first through third floors.

c6b97453-d8d8-5aa9-baff-e2981ec4e9e6.content: The end of regular opening hours for the Main Building main entrance during the academic term is 10 p.m.

614389e2-3b83-5fbb-bac1-07cb20f2e4fa.content: The end of regular opening hours for the Main Building main entrance during recess is 10 p.m.

e3929a49-e9b9-566c-bdc2-296ad7ee086a.content: Students familiar with the route to the Central Library expect the third-floor rear entrance to be a connection normally available for passage.

4ed338df-7bd0-5801-bb3b-535886f6d007.content: The access information agent can explain the posted opening hours.

2af35f74-abb5-54ae-aca6-7d315270ae57.content: The access information agent can explain the posted access eligibility requirements.

c30faae3-e8de-530c-a279-cb7a33133bc8.content: The access information agent cannot issue access credentials.

5b1a6f72-c56d-515f-bb2d-9cd443275bff.content: The access information agent cannot unlock locked doors.

b6987cd9-7198-56b5-bf6f-0162624db30f.content: Instruct students eligible for access after regular opening hours to use a physical NFC student ID card or the registered app.

f80ad345-f0ce-54bc-bd8d-e2f0e1f1b1c0.content: If access authentication fails, check the posted contact information for the responsible office before providing guidance.

732458c0-fedc-5bc7-965e-36f8d46c4d8a.content: Do not guess an unverified contact number.

cb1e0734-91ce-53f3-b00c-da4734df5cb5.content: The staff-only entrance is a controlled entrance separate from the third-floor rear entrance.

36db4bf8-285c-573b-8127-0efa0c10f8bd.content: The accessible route beside the main entrance is an always-available route into the first-floor lobby without using stairs.

804bfc6b-188b-5579-bc83-10b04a28bd69.content: Tour leaders for external groups tend to want to use the same route through the third-floor rear entrance on their next visit that they used on a previous visit.

cc2a0d18-0b49-5923-9b53-2e68140b13a0.content: The start of regular opening hours for the Main Building main entrance during the academic term is 7 a.m.

3ca6b6b2-c381-5247-83cc-cfad0ce862f7.content: The start of regular opening hours for the Main Building main entrance during recess is 8 a.m.

4a01fd2b-fb4d-5759-88c9-1b6de1a30331.content: The Main Building's regular weekend opening hours are posted separately in the weekend operating schedule.

78298531-74b8-591b-ae32-b6175f476ca7.content: The Main Building's holiday access hours may differ from regular operating hours.

4189e656-a4ef-5fe0-af68-943d86e83a83.content: First-time visitors often expect the Main Building first-floor main entrance to be the default entrance for general visitors.

aee44d0a-5c4c-59ec-b350-b229570fbd09.content: Visitors who have difficulty using stairs expect a step-free access route to be near the main entrance.

d2f32d9e-7b85-5720-ad36-80c6f5f1c071.content: Valid staff access eligibility is required to use the staff-only entrance.

2d97d6b9-4287-5f52-9801-26d2081b111f.content: The Main Building service entrance is used for preregistered deliveries and facilities work.

fef275b1-b2c1-5cc5-8f75-a1d01782a1e0.content: Visitors accompanied by children prefer the stroller-accessible main entrance and accessible route to be closely connected.

41d5bf0b-9a62-5821-b3fd-60f58ce2d980.content: Taxi and ride-hailing drivers often expect the Main Building first-floor main entrance to be the default drop-off point unless the passenger specifies a different entrance.

7da885c1-0515-516c-ad1f-2a445db9b324.content: The access information agent can explain the difference between the normal uses of the front and rear entrances.

27f6e089-b303-59da-ba5d-4a845961c466.content: The access information agent cannot check the physical lock state in real time at the time of an inquiry.

5e9fc7b5-cfb8-5e3f-9a53-35568e0fd216.content: If the posted operating hours differ from the access signage on site, instruct people to follow the on-site signage.

bb601c38-6e41-5328-a7e0-117a8a101e49.content: Do not suggest that a person without access eligibility follow another authenticated user inside.

efffd1fe-923a-5f12-bd50-afd997a41209.content: Emergency exits are doors for emergency evacuation and are not regular entrances for general access.

2b2642c9-32ff-51d5-8a3c-e48d64e191ea.content: The automatic door at the Main Building main entrance operates during regular opening hours.

e55771f0-7a62-5b9e-aa16-97beafed30fe.content: Service animals may use the Main Building's general entrances together with their users.

2ed45e16-4f36-5ecd-919e-65c622c1b493.content: Instruct people not to ride bicycles or personal mobility devices inside the Main Building.

9374def9-c634-5af1-96d8-4d7163608027.content: Visitors using strollers may use the accessible route beside the main entrance.

70fe5986-785a-51be-ad59-3e53aab0abb7.content: Group-tour visitors often expect their tour leader to wait in the first-floor main entrance lobby.

411fa9fb-6bf1-5514-8433-d6e1c186260c.content: External workers may confuse the separate check-in procedure at the service entrance with the general visitor procedure.

66b1d3f3-b59f-572a-a729-012a3101cb98.content: Borrowed visitor access passes must be returned to the information desk before leaving the Main Building.

e99d3f15-48ee-5dc7-8eb2-52ea2d725a09.content: Direct users who have lost their access credentials to the posted access support desk.

430563f2-c0f4-53ee-9846-2ecd3f57877c.content: The accessible entrance beside the main entrance has an automatic door.

2052527b-612c-5af8-974a-ed21323a3b1a.content: The vestibule inside the main entrance is between the outside and the lobby.

5bf2c18d-2844-5471-a790-fa6b4689fb37.content: Nighttime access to the Main Building follows an eligibility policy separate from general opening.

38a17415-7c46-562c-bb10-9fa23de62291.content: The validity of campus-issued access eligibility depends on the user's affiliation status.

625a9fcb-4609-5a1d-b6af-437e5c722458.content: Support for mobile access authentication may vary by campus building.

f3f4e4ff-720d-520f-ae1f-53823c277f1e.content: Registered visitors to public events use the entrance designated in the event information.

e3435ec0-eae9-560c-a2ef-76a89761386a.content: The hours when an event-only entrance is available follow the schedule for that event.

a24cd65b-b2c3-515e-997b-77a6e143c992.content: Student groups expect to be able to meet their party immediately in the main entrance lobby during large visits.

22dcad33-41cd-5b46-9df6-a98d005f03f3.content: If an item left at an entrance obstructs passage, report it through the facilities reporting agent.

da9f2a7d-5b3d-532d-928b-bab7c97f500b.content: Direct visitors who need on-site access support to the first-floor information desk.
